repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate introduced an absolute-value fold (lines 4-7) to handle negative differences, but the IR only triggers on a rise ($t2 - t1 >= 3$). Evidence F2 shows the IR did nothing (empty action list) because the temperature dropped (diff < 0), while the candidate incorrectly triggered the action. F3 confirms the candidate computed `diff` and folded it, violating the signed arithmetic requirement of the IR.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the absolute-value folding logic. The script now preserves the exact signed difference calculation and the IR's specific trigger condition ($t2 - t1 >= 3$) without modifying negative results.
